correctness.rationale: Only (-1)-curves are negative by adjunction and anticanonical ampleness. The displayed sixteen curves exhaust the degree-four exceptional configurations and the graph has forty intersection pairs. A support is negative definite exactly when pairwise disjoint. For an invariant support B the divisor -K+2B descends; P=-K+B is zero on B and positive on every other irreducible curve (ampleness plus nonnegative intersections with B), with P²=4+|B|>0. Thus it is big nef and the negative part is exactly B; strict positivity away from B and positive negative coefficients give the interior. In the even-bit graph the sixteen translations act transitively. An automorphism fixing 0 permutes its five weight-four neighbors, which in turn distinguish all ten weight-two vertices by adjacency. Hence the affine Weyl model is the whole graph group; the usual Weyl subgroup of order 1920 acts faithfully. Odd dimension ensures no signed class splits on passing from the full signed group to its even subgroup: an odd-length cycle provides an odd centralizing sign flip on that entire cycle. Exact integer-power orbit-block counting on the independently reconstructed Gram supports and divisor inversion matches class sizes, all eighteen fixed-size polynomials and all eighteen orbit profiles (including two invariant conjugate pairs with no individually fixed curve for 3+ 1− 1−). Frobenius inversion does not change these counts. The zeta formula is for the finite chamber set, not for the surface.
residual_risks: No per-field realization of all signed types was claimed or checked; the graph argument is conditional on the specified smooth geometry.
